object: skid-mounted diesel generator: cast engine block, alternator, radiator, sheet control cabinet, exhaust silencer
understanding: Mostly castings and thick steel: the engine, alternator and skid do not deform in any event short of an explosion. Only the sheet parts move: control cabinet, radiator shroud, silencer shell, guards.
So wreckage here is shallow dents in the sheet parts, bent pipes, and above all surface: heat rust on the exhaust, oil and soot, flaking paint.
Rust is heavy on the silencer and manifold, at the skid, and wherever water pools on top; grime is everywhere.
